why: Opposite boxes match. Top-right and bottom-left both have four small boxes with one slanting line. So bottom-right must match top-left: a plain square with one line from bottom-left to top-right. Option 4 is exactly that. Options 1, 2 and 3 have an extra short line.
trick: In a 2x2 picture, compare boxes that are diagonally opposite.
